notes: STICKS AND STRINGS - WAR! now takes orders from a gamepad: a stick-driven cursor, A to select and give orders, double and triple presses to muster your buddies, LB/RB to walk the command bar. And every Arcade cabinet has its own classical piece now: Flight of the Bumblebee for Super Buddy Run, Ride of the Valkyries for WAR!, Greensleeves in the Castle, the Mountain King creeping through Entrances, the can-can for Tank Rescue, the William Tell gallop for the Cart, and Sheep May Safely Graze over Buddy Craft.
